editorial_intent: Diagram the conserved C1QB complement cascade tagging functional synaptic junctions for microglial phagocytic engulfment during brain aging.
subject: A multi-scale biophysical schematic depicting presynaptic and postsynaptic membranes where C1QB molecular tags bind to synaptic proteins, engaging a geometric microglial phagocytic receptor domain that initiates selective membrane engulfment.
setting: A minimalist background structured around a geometric cranial meridian dome, a 24-division circadian astrolabe calibration arc, and a phase-coherent geodesic neural constellation rendered in ultra-fine line work.
composition: Asymmetric Post-Constructivist dual-panel lithograph layout showing a left-to-right temporal progression: pristine synaptic alignment transitioning to C1QB complement tagging and microglial engulfment, anchored by precise Bauhaus grid lines.
